import math,cmath,json
sq=math.sqrt
def mm(A,B):return[[sum(A[i][k]*B[k][j]for k in range(len(B)))for j in range(len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(A))]
def dg(A):return[[A[j][i].conjugate()for j in range(len(A))]for i in range(len(A[0]))]
def kr(A,B):return[[A[i//len(B)][j//len(B[0])]*B[i%len(B)][j%len(B[0])]for j in range(len(A[0])*len(B[0]))]for i in range(len(A)*len(B))]
def err(A,B):return max(abs(A[i][j]-B[i][j])for i in range(len(A))for j in range(len(A[0])))
I=[[1,0],[0,1]]; EA=[[1/sq(2)],[0],[0],[1/sq(2)]];EB=[[0],[1/sq(2)],[-1/sq(2)],[0]];JB=[[1,0],[0,-1]]
VG=[[-sq(3)+1j,0],[0,-2j],[1+1j*sq(3),0],[0,2]];VH=[[z.conjugate()for z in row]for row in VG]
aG=(-sq(3)-1j)/2;aH=(-sq(3)+1j)/2
VG=[[aG*z/(2*sq(2))for z in row]for row in VG];VH=[[aH*z/(2*sq(2))for z in row]for row in VH]
LA=mm(kr(EA,I),I);LB=mm(kr(EB,I),JB);RG=mm(kr(I,VG),VH);RH=mm(kr(I,VH),VG)
pathsL=[LA,LB];pathsR=[RG,RH];F=[];nonscalar=0
for L in pathsL:
 row=[]
 for R in pathsR:
  M=mm(dg(L),R);q=(M[0][0]+M[1][1])/2;nonscalar=max(nonscalar,err(M,[[q,0],[0,q]]));row.append(q)
 F.append(row)
u=mm(dg(F),F);print(json.dumps({'F':[[str(z)for z in row]for row in F],'scalar_residual':nonscalar,'unitarity_residual':err(u,I)},indent=2));assert nonscalar<1e-12 and err(u,I)<1e-12
